claims.statement: After Athens’ defeat, an oligarchic government known as the Thirty took power with Spartan backing. Opposition to its rule developed into civil war. The regime was short-lived. Democratic forces recovered ground, and a settlement in 403 BCE restored democracy.
Acropolis reference for Athens, not the exact event location
